assessment.diversity_evidence: All 20 stories concern Jun’s missing whale book on a high shelf, recovered by Ms Alvarez with a ladder and followed by shared reading. The minor branch is whether Mina explicitly returns the atlas to help (for example, s000014 versus s000058); wording changes such as “saw” and “spotted” do not create new plots. This sampled set is highly repetitive and does not establish the diversity of the full generator.

plot_groups.summary: Mina promises to help Jun find his missing whale book; Jun notices a clue on the high shelf, and Ms Alvarez uses a ladder to retrieve it, after which they read together.
Mina puts aside or returns her moon atlas and chooses to help Jun; Ms Alvarez retrieves the whale book from the high shelf with a ladder, and the children read together.
